description: Make malformed columns, orientation, page_width_em, and table_widths values obey the documented warn-and-continue contract. Normalize or reject invalid values, prevent the confirmed columns AttributeError, and continue with documented safe defaults. Cover booleans, non-positive and non-finite numbers, case variants, malformed structures, and injection-like strings without narrowing established valid inputs unexpectedly.
title: Remediate unsafe front-matter width controls
